description: This file implements an E2 network client factory with classes for converting and forwarding E2AP PDUs over SCTP, including connection handling and PDU packing/unpacking.

classes.name: sctp_to_e2_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts packed E2AP PDUs from SCTP into unpacked PDUs and forwards to E2 agent.

classes.name: e2_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts unpacked E2AP PDUs from E2 agent into packed PDUs and forwards over SCTP.

classes.name: e2_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Manages SCTP connection for E2 network, handling connection requests and PDU forwarding.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SCTP SDU, unpacks E2AP PDU, and forwards to E2 agent.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Handles new E2 message, packs into SCTP SDU, and forwards.

methods.name: handle_e2_connection_request
methods.description: Establishes SCTP connection and returns PDU notifier.
